channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in Australia
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: Intrepid x Amble walking adventure giveaway – Intrepid Travel
item.description: Prize: Place on an Intrepid walking trip in Australia, return flights from nearest capital, $1,000 Amble outdoor gear. Deadline: November 6, 2026. Sign up to the Intrepid and Amble newsletters and say in 50 words or less why you should win (judged). Australian residents 18+

item.title: Win a $4,000 Home Refresh – Ecosa × The Print Emporium
item.description: Prize: $3,500 Ecosa voucher + $500 The Print Emporium voucher. Deadline: November 8, 2026. Enter your details in the form (follow both on Instagram as asked). See T&Cs on the page

item.title: The Nature Photography Contest 2026 – The Nature Photography Contest
item.description: Prize: €2,000 in cash prizes. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Upload nature photos on the contest website. Open internationally

item.title: Viking 'Your Choice 2026' Competition – Viking River Cruises Australia
item.description: Prize: $20,000 AUD Viking future cruise voucher (voyages 2027–2028, flights not included). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Submit the entry form on the page; 1 entry per email. Australia and New Zealand residents 18+

item.title: Peter Jackson Win a Wardrobe – Peter Jackson
item.description: Prize: $2,000 AUD Peter Jackson gift card. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the page. No purchase necessary. Australian residents 18+
